body:
New LevelExit.target_spawner_id -- overrides destination-level spawner selection with one exact, author-chosen spawner by id, for seamless GTA-style building interiors. Found+fixed a real gap: LevelSpawner never parsed its own author-assigned id from JSON at all. New custom_level_pick_spawner_by_id, honest miss on stale/zero id. story_check_level_exits/lobby_check_story_level_exits both capture the firing exit and override respawn position. 10/10 new tests green, make server/lobby clean. SHANKPIT 7287957.

⚓ ☃
title: Level exits target a specific destination spawner (S491)
